5: The tooth hooks the wood inward. Tony’s palm stays planted beside it on the same bowing center panel. Its edge is still seated in the frame.

The slab hangs from the Fiend’s tooth. Sean catches the left jamb. Tony pitches through the right half of the opening, one knee at the broken rail and a palm on restroom tile. His head and shoulders are inside the doorway. His planted arm recedes into the room, with the hand farther from the reader than his shoulder.
The Fiend lunges open-mouthed. Tony brings the attached nozzle up outside its jaws. Sean is poised at the left. The broken slab lies on the tile.
In the same instant, Tony drives the jetter nozzle across the closing jaws and Sean lands a punch on the near porcelain brow, starting a jagged crack.
6: Tony wrenches the nozzle to the right. Its tip is still between the teeth as several teeth snap loose and fly right with the barrel.
The Fiend lunges into the corridor. Tony is clear to the right holding the nozzle. Sean holds the plunger on the left, facing the cracked cheek.
Sean drives the red cup against the crack. The head strikes the solid right jamb and a section of bowl splits away. Tony is low and clear.

Half the bowl on carpet, broken tank on tile, collapsed pipe legs, dark eye by Sean. Plunger cup remains on the largest piece. Both men survey the wreckage. Applause fades beyond the closed ballroom doors.

P6P4: So what do I put on the work order?
Toilet removed. Customer to select replacement.

continuity.P6P1–P6P4: The extraction breaks a cluster of upper and lower teeth to the reader’s right in the frontal view. Follow the same section of the Fiend’s left jaw through changes of angle and into the wreckage wherever visible.
